company_type: Well-funded Indo-US green-hydrogen scaleup, HQ US, manufacturing Bangalore

technology.description: Ohmium designs, manufactures, and deploys modular PEM electrolysers from a Bangalore gigafactory. Patented stack design with dynamic ramping capability that pairs with intermittent renewable electricity. Compact stackable units allow scaling from MW to GW with standardised modules.
technology.problem_solved: Reduces installation cost and time for green hydrogen production by enabling modular deployment; addresses ramp-rate mismatch with renewables.
technology.innovation_summary: Patented electrolyser with dynamic ramping; partnered with IIT Madras Research Park for cost-reduction R&D; selected by NTPC Renewable Energy for up to 400 MW deployments.
technology.unique_selling_points: PEM modular design; Bangalore gigafactory (one of few in India); $250M Series C from TPG Rise Climate (2023); >2 GW global pipeline
technology.application_area: Green ammonia (NTPC), refineries (replacing grey H2), green steel (Tata Steel adjacency), transportation
technology.target_industries: Power utilities, refineries, fertilizer companies, steel makers, hydrogen fuel logistics
technology.potential_customers: NTPC, IOC, BPCL, HPCL, Reliance, Tata Steel (already partner via Tata Projects EPC deal)
technology.trl_level: 8 (System complete and qualified, deployed at MW scale)
technology.institution_name: In-house + IIT Madras Research Park collaboration
technology.dsir_recognition_status: India subsidiary eligible (Ohmium India Pvt Ltd)
technology.estimated_market_size: India green hydrogen mission target: 5 MMT by 2030; electrolyser market ~$15B globally
technology.preferred_license_type: Patent Buyout (high-value, deep IP) for any tech inflow they license from NRDC; outbound licensing rare
technology.certification_status: PESO clearance pathway; CE marking on export units; ISO 9001/14001
